problems: Cliopatria's 'Free City of Lübeck' row (1806..1870, 5 shapes) is Mecklenburg-Strelitz (Neustrelitz and Ratzeburg land, 2,551-2,754 km2); Lübeck itself is 298 km2 and has no cell in the 1806 shape. free-city-of-lubeck marks 1806 wrong and the rest adjust; the extra dossier mecklenburg-strelitz (cliopatria_names empty, new keyframes from those shapes) was written because no row names Strelitz. The orchestrator may rename the rows instead.

Cliopatria's 'Duchy of Nassau' 1806, 1809 and 1811 shapes carry a northern lobe to 52.7 N that no page supports (11,345 / 16,877 / 11,636 km2 against 4,700 km2 on the German Confederation page); cut back to the 1807 outline.

Cliopatria's Wikipedia title for 'Duchy of Mecklenburg' is a medieval duchy (1471-1520, 1695-1701); the dossier is Mecklenburg-Schwerin and cites the Grand Duchy and Duchy of Mecklenburg-Schwerin pages. Its predecessor is the eu-09-x dossier mecklenburg, which draws both Mecklenburg duchies to 1805.
All Oldenburg shapes lack Eutin (adjust everywhere); Birkenfeld and Jever enter Cliopatria in 1820 but 1815 and 1818 on the pages.
Bergedorf is drawn in both free-city-of-lubeck (to 1867) and Hamburg's Cliopatria row: an intended overlap (condominium) ended by Lübeck's 1868 sale.
Bremen and Lübeck dossiers carry a 1813 gain, but the German mediatisation page (opened for Baden) says Bremen was 'restored 1814'; recorded as a disagreement.

Eutin, Birkenfeld, Jever, Bergedorf, Katzenelnbogen, Siegen and Wetzlar are not in the gazetteer and are drawn as lon/lat circles so nothing fails to resolve; resolve warnings remain only for counterpart slugs without dossiers (principality-of-birkenfeld, lordship-of-jever in Oldenburg; free-imperial-city-of-bremen in Bremen).

WebFetch summaries were occasionally thin or wrongly assigned dates (Peace of Prague page names none of the annexed states; Vegesack page one line); every date used was taken from the sentence the fetch returned. 23 distinct pages were opened (33 source entries across the dossiers); one page failed (Hanseatic_Departments, url_not_found; Bouches-du-Weser and Bouches-de-l'Elbe were used instead).
